hook_text: Pretoria, Cape Town and George all get rain, but at very different times of the year.
clip_script: George, Western Cape. Three bar graphs on the board. Pretoria: tall bars in summer, almost nothing in winter. That is summer rainfall, from afternoon thunderstorms, across most of South Africa. Cape Town: the opposite. Tall bars in winter, from cold fronts off the Atlantic. That is winter rainfall. And George: even bars, all year round. That is all-year rainfall, keeping the Garden Route green. Find the tallest bars, and you know the pattern.
visual_style: Whiteboard three bar graphs growing month by month, then a map of South Africa coloured in three rainfall zones.
mood: Bright and puzzle-solving, like a detective game.
pacing: One graph at a time, then all three side by side.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out which rainfall pattern your town has.
